panels.description: The hostname and operating band of the Access Point currently serving the client.

panels.description: The WLAN/SSID name the client is currently associated with.
panels.title: Connected SSID

panels.description: Quality Score (AQI) indicates the overall RF health (100 is best). Interfering Devices shows the count of non-Wi-Fi interference sources (e.g., microwaves, Bluetooth). Background Noise indicates the noise floor level in dBm.

targets.expr: (round(avg_over_time(wnc_ap_air_quality_index_min[$rollup_interval])) * on(mac, radio) group_left(name, band) (max by(mac, radio, name, band) (wnc_ap_info) and on(name, band) label_replace(max by(ap, band) (wnc_client_info{mac="$mac"}), "name", "$1", "ap", "(.*)"))) or on(mac, radio) (100 * (max by(mac, radio, name, band) (wnc_ap_info) and on(name, band) label_replace(max by(ap, band) (wnc_client_info{mac="$mac"}), "name", "$1", "ap", "(.*)")))

(round(max_over_time(wnc_ap_interferers[$rollup_interval])) * on(mac, radio) group_left(name, band) (max by(mac, radio, name, band) (wnc_ap_info) and on(name, band) label_replace(max by(ap, band) (wnc_client_info{mac="$mac"}), "name", "$1", "ap", "(.*)"))) or on(mac, radio) (0 * (max by(mac, radio, name, band) (wnc_ap_info) and on(name, band) label_replace(max by(ap, band) (wnc_client_info{mac="$mac"}), "name", "$1", "ap", "(.*)")))

round(avg_over_time(wnc_ap_noise_floor_dbm[$rollup_interval])) * on(mac, radio) group_left(name, band) (max by(mac, radio, name, band) (wnc_ap_info) and on(name, band) label_replace(max by(ap, band) (wnc_client_info{mac="$mac"}), "name", "$1", "ap", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Wi-Fi Quality & Interference on Same AP & Band

panels.description: Total Congestion shows the overall channel utilization percentage. Noise Congestion shows the percentage of the channel blocked by non-Wi-Fi noise.

targets.expr: avg_over_time(wnc_ap_channel_utilization_ratio[$rollup_interval]) * on(mac, radio) group_left(name, band) (max by(mac, radio, name, band) (wnc_ap_info) and on(name, band) label_replace(max by(ap, band) (wnc_client_info{mac="$mac"}), "name", "$1", "ap", "(.*)"))

avg_over_time(wnc_ap_noise_utilization_ratio[$rollup_interval]) * on(mac, radio) group_left(name, band) (max by(mac, radio, name, band) (wnc_ap_info) and on(name, band) label_replace(max by(ap, band) (wnc_client_info{mac="$mac"}), "name", "$1", "ap", "(.*)"))
